boundaries.name: CLI composition root
boundaries.$comment: Composition root (src/Strata.Cli/Boundary.fs). Every command runs inside Boundary.attempt; failures no adapter translated into a typed result are classified here, recorded through Aegis with Blocking delivery, and shown as a safe message and reference. Programming defects and cancellation are re-raised (Aegis core 19, 29).

boundaries.name: PostgreSQL catalog and deployment adapter
boundaries.$comment: Typed host/application outcomes remain authoritative. A DbException that escapes the adapter is classified as STRATA.POSTGRES.FAILURE at the CLI composition boundary (the Cli tests on DbException, not Npgsql's type, because only Strata.Host.Postgres references Npgsql). A malformed connection string is refused as a typed outcome by ConnectionString.validate before any command runs.

boundaries.name: Filesystem corpus and artifact adapter
boundaries.$comment: Expected read/validation failures remain typed results. An IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException that escapes the host is classified as STRATA.FILES.FAILURE at the CLI composition boundary.
